description: The page URL on 127.0.0.1 redirects to the same port under the hostname localhost, which is then processed.

thin.note: Page redirects must stay on the allowed host: localhost:18981 is not 127.0.0.1:18981. Unlike redirect-page-off-host (same hostname, other port) this redirect changes the HOSTNAME, so it must fail under a hostname comparison (what isAllowedUrl(url, ALLOWED_HOSTNAME) is) as well as under host:port.
